stem.text: A vaccine is used to create artificial active immunity. After a person has been given a vaccine, it takes a period of time before they develop long-term immunity to the disease.
Which statement about this period of time explains the delay in developing long-term immunity?

A.text: **No** memory cells have been produced from B-lymphocytes.

B.text: **No** plasma cells have been produced from B-lymphocytes.

C.text: The primary immune response has **not** produced enough antibodies.

D.text: The secondary immune response has **not** produced enough antibodies.
